name: agent-autonomous-developer
description: Turns agent-project-issues tickets into draft pull requests for projects in any language (stack auto-detected). Ships two skills — orchestrate-tickets (dispatches conflict-free parallel ticket work across git worktrees and launches one background Claude session per ticket) and process-ticket (an end-to-end context→plan→code→review→PR pipeline) — backed by five subagents. Drives the agent-project-issues and agent-worktree MCPs.
